# GEOX — Earth Intelligence Sovereign Kernel (27 Public Tools)
> Doctrine: Physics before narrative. Governed evidence only.
> Surface: generated from src/geox_mcp/tools_manifest.yaml

## 1. Canonical Tool Surface

1. **geox_well_ingest**: Load well log data from LAS, SEG-Y, DST, deviation, or tops files. Auto-detects format.
2. **geox_petrophysics**: Unified petrophysics: Vsh, porosity, Sw, permeability, net pay, LEM inference, QC. Modes: generate, verify, lem_inference, stoip_feed, qc.
3. **geox_observe**: Canonical multimodal Earth observation umbrella (Earth Witness v1). Rock/outcrop/core/thin_section/fossil/seismic_display/map/section intake → governed EarthObservationPacket. Vision output is EVIDENCE only; interpretations stay HYPOTHESIS; no hydrocarbon claim from image alone (I1-I9); missing diagnostics → INPUT_REQUIRED; local ceiling QUALIFIED_CANDIDATE — arifOS seals only.
4. **geox_seismic_ingest**: SEG-Y I/O, header inspection, export.
5. **geox_seismic_compute**: Seismic computation: forward model, well tie, attributes, wavelet extraction, inversion.
6. **geox_seismic_interpret**: One semantic capability — propose geometry, physics-gate, compare hypotheses (NOT autonomous SEAL). Live modes: horizon_contrast, fault_sticks, volume_frame, blend, structure_validate, interpret (interpretation_bundle ≥3 hyps), interpret_section/rsi_pipeline (INT_SEISMIC), segy_slice. Gates return PASS|WARN|KILL|UNMEASURED + receipt_hash. preferred_hypothesis always null from GEOX. Local max QUALIFIED_CANDIDATE — arifOS seals only.
7. **geox_basin**: Unified basin intelligence: profile, resolve, macrostrat, backstrip, mass balance, thermal maturity, map context, deep time, tectonic reconstruction.
8. **geox_paleobiodb_query**: Query the Paleobiology Database (PBDB v1.2) for taxa, occurrences, and biozones. Modes: taxa (resolve a taxon), occurrence (fossil occurrence records), zone (biozones by scale), age_intervals (ICS / nanno / foram zones). Read-only, public-domain fossil data.
9. **geox_geomechanics**: Geomechanical analysis: bulk/shear/young modulus, poisson ratio, acoustic impedance, stress polygon.
10. **geox_prospect**: Prospect evaluation: volumetrics, POS, EVOI, risk assessment. Modes: screen, evaluate.
11. **geox_well_qc**: Quality control for well data: depth monotonicity, null %, physical range checks.
12. **geox_temporal**: Temporal analytics: decline curve, RRR, basin lifecycle, cadence. Modes: decline, rrr, basin_lifecycle, cadence.
13. **geox_map**: Map intelligence: layer discovery, scene composition, preview. Modes: layers_list, scene_plan, render_preview.
14. **geox_source**: Source rock & diagenesis: TOC, kerogen, maturity, compaction. Modes: source_rock, diagenesis.
15. **geox_spatial**: Spatial intelligence: H3, LanceDB, STAC. Modes: h3_index, lancedb_store, stac_discover.
16. **geox_deep_time**: Deep time: Earth state, dynamical systems, DDE reasoning. Modes: dde_reason.
17. **geox_claim**: Claim lifecycle: create, validate, challenge, seal, evidence, falsify, synthesize, contradict. Modes: create, validate, challenge, seal, attach, falsify, discover, synthesize, abduct, contradict, scan.
18. **geox_model**: Geological modeling: subsurface inversion, 2D cross-sections, GemPy 3D. Modes: subsurface, geological_generate, gempy_3d.
19. **geox_well**: Well intelligence: view curves, open desk, desurvey. Modes: view, desk.
20. **geox_contrast_metabolize**: Unified anomalous contrast metabolic pipeline. Binds three stages into one call: ISOLATE (deterministic acoustic impedance contrast detection) then MEASURE (AVO gradient + LMR estimates) then CLASSIFY (>=3 stratigraphic trap hypotheses). substrate_class=INERT. Local max QUALIFIED_CANDIDATE - arifOS seals.
21. **geox_glof**: Unified GLOF multi-phase cascade simulation. Multi-phase physics: solid dam → granular debris → liquid flood (Mohr-Coulomb + Saint-Venant + 33D zen-33 state). Modes: run (full cascade in one call), inverse (Bayesian grid-search), mcmc (MCMC posterior), propagate (Saint-Venant 1D), phase (yield surface debug). Replaces 7 individual geox_glof_cascade_* tools (333 ARCHITECT 2026-09-19).
22. **geox_surface_status**: Canonical registry probe: public surface truth (count, canonical_tools, verdict). Self-witness for surface SOT.
23. **geox_calibration_register_witness**: Register a CalibrationWitness for structural interpretation. Validates schema, checks completeness blockers (missing axes, depth-without-velocity). Returns VOID on bad input, HOLD on missing calibration.
24. **geox_extract_display_proxy**: Extract display-derived proxy from raster seismic image. Requires CalibrationWitness. Output labeled DISPLAY_DERIVED_PROXY — NOT suitable for AVO, amplitude preservation, or native well-tie.
25. **geox_register_native_source**: Register a native SEG-Y source for trace extraction. Validates file existence, computes SHA256, extracts binary header metadata. Authority downgrade: OPERATOR_APPROVED without actor → UNVERIFIED.
26. **geox_extract_native_trace**: Extract a native seismic trace from a registered source. Returns NativeTraceRef with full provenance. HOLD for unverified authority, restricted data, or missing source.
27. **geox_list_registered_sources**: List all registered native seismic sources with classification, authority, trace count, and sample metadata.

## 2. Agent Reasoning Logic
- Evidence before interpretation.
- Governance stays server-side.
- App-enabled workspace URI: `ui://geox/workspace-v1.html` (text/html;profile=mcp-app).
